explain.es: El third conditional (tercer condicional) sirve para hablar de una situación imaginaria en el pasado: algo que no ocurrió y el resultado que habría tenido. Como el pasado ya no se puede cambiar, lo usamos mucho para lamentarnos (si hubiera estudiado…), criticar o sentir alivio (si no hubieras llamado, me habría dormido). Equivale al español «si hubiera / hubiese + participio, habría + participio».
explain.en: The third conditional talks about an imaginary past: something that didn't happen and its imaginary result. We use it for regrets, criticism and relief.

explain.title: Truco: IF + HAD · WOULD + HAVE
explain.es: If y would no se sientan nunca en la misma mitad de la frase. Si ves if, piensa en had; en la otra mitad, would have. Y si te cuesta, tradúcelo mentalmente: si hubiera… = had, habría… = would have.
explain.en: IF + HAD · WOULD + HAVE. If and would never share the same half of the sentence.

explain.title: 1 · La forma
explain.es: La oración tiene dos partes. En la condición (la parte del if) va el past perfect: had + participio. En el resultado va would have + participio. El participio es la 3.ª columna de los irregulares (go → went → gone). Las dos partes pueden ir en cualquier orden: si el if va primero, ponemos coma; si va segundo, no.
explain.en: Two parts: If + had + past participle (condition) and would have + past participle (result). Either order is fine; use a comma only when the if-clause comes first.

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
examples.es: Si hubiera estudiado más, habría aprobado el examen.

examples.en: She would have got the job if she had applied earlier.
examples.es: Habría conseguido el trabajo si se hubiera presentado antes.

examples.en: If we had taken a taxi, we would have arrived on time.
examples.es: Si hubiéramos cogido un taxi, habríamos llegado a tiempo.

explain.title: 2 · Negativa
explain.es: Para negar usamos hadn't + participio (condición) y wouldn't have + participio (resultado). Casi siempre le damos la vuelta a la realidad: si algo pasó, la condición va en negativa, y al revés.
explain.en: Use hadn't + participle and wouldn't have + participle. We usually reverse reality: if something happened, the condition is negative.

examples.en: If it hadn't rained, we would have had the barbecue outside.
examples.es: Si no hubiera llovido, habríamos hecho la barbacoa fuera.

examples.en: I wouldn't have been late if I hadn't missed the bus.
examples.es: No habría llegado tarde si no hubiera perdido el autobús.

examples.en: If you hadn't reminded me, I would have forgotten her birthday.
examples.es: Si no me lo hubieras recordado, me habría olvidado de su cumpleaños.

explain.title: 3 · Preguntas
explain.es: En las preguntas, would salta delante del sujeto: Would + sujeto + have + participio…? La parte del if mantiene el orden normal. Son muy útiles para hablar de alternativas: ¿qué habrías hecho tú?
explain.en: In questions, would goes before the subject: Would + subject + have + participle…? The if-clause keeps normal word order.

examples.en: What would you have done if you had lost your passport?
examples.es: ¿Qué habrías hecho si hubieras perdido el pasaporte?

examples.en: Would you have accepted the offer if they had paid you more?
examples.es: ¿Habrías aceptado la oferta si te hubieran pagado más?

examples.en: Where would they have stayed if the hotel had been full?
examples.es: ¿Dónde se habrían alojado si el hotel hubiera estado lleno?

Parte IF

explain.note: Solo en el third las dos partes hablan del pasado. ¿Resultado ahora? → mixed.

explain.title: ¿Second o third?
explain.es: La diferencia está en el tiempo del que hablamos, igual que en español: si tuviera (ahora) frente a si hubiera tenido (antes). ¡Ojo! had had es correcto: el primer had es el auxiliar y el segundo es el participio de have.
explain.en: Second = unreal present or future. Third = unreal past. had had is correct!

cols.head: 🕒 Second · ahora / futuro
items: If I had money, I would buy it.

cols.head: ⏪ Third · pasado
items: If I had had money, I would have bought it.
Si hubiera tenido dinero, lo habría comprado.
If she had known, she would have told us.
Si lo hubiera sabido, nos lo habría dicho.

explain.title: El misterio de 'd
head: Forma corta · Short
Forma larga · Long
Pista · Clue
rows: If you'd told me, I'd have helped.
If you had told me, I would have helped.
explain.note: Al hablar, would have suena /ˈwʊdəv/ («wúdov»). ¡Por eso hasta algunos nativos escriben mal would of! Lo correcto siempre es would have (o 'd have).
explain.note_en: In speech would have sounds like /ˈwʊdəv/ — never write would of.

explain.title: 4 · Could have y might have
explain.es: En el resultado podemos cambiar would por otros modales para matizar: could have + participio = habría podido / podría haber (posibilidad o capacidad) y might have + participio = quizá habría (resultado no seguro). Would have indica un resultado seguro.
explain.en: In the result clause, could have = would have been able to; might have = perhaps would have. Would have = a certain result.

examples.en: If I'd had a car, I could have given you a lift.
examples.es: Si hubiera tenido coche, te podría haber llevado.

examples.en: If you'd asked her nicely, she might have said yes.
examples.es: Si se lo hubieras pedido con amabilidad, quizá habría dicho que sí.

examples.en: We could have won the match if Leo hadn't been injured.
examples.es: Podríamos haber ganado el partido si Leo no hubiera estado lesionado.

explain.title: 5 · Arrepentimientos, críticas y alivio
explain.es: El third conditional es la forma natural de lamentarse por el pasado, de reprochar algo a otra persona y de expresar alivio porque algo malo no pasó. (Los lamentos con wish e if only los verás en su propio mapa.)
explain.en: Use it for regrets, criticism and relief about the past.

examples.en: If I'd listened to my parents, I wouldn't have wasted so much money.

examples.en: If you had checked the report, the client wouldn't have complained.

examples.en: If he hadn't braked, he would have hit the cyclist.
examples.es: Si no hubiera frenado, habría atropellado al ciclista. (alivio)

explain.title: 6 · Mixed conditionals (básico)
explain.es:
A veces la condición es pasada pero el resultado es ahora, o al revés. Entonces mezclamos:
A) If + past perfect → would + infinitivo: algo pasado con consecuencia hoy (si hubiera estudiado Medicina, ahora sería médico).
B) If + past simple → would have + participio: algo que siempre es así con consecuencia pasada (si no fuera tan tímido, le habría hablado).
Pista: busca now, today, still.
explain.en: Past condition → present result: If + past perfect, would + infinitive. Present condition → past result: If + past simple, would have + participle.

examples.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.es: Si hubiera estudiado Medicina, ahora sería médico.

examples.en: If she hadn't moved to London, she wouldn't speak such good English.
examples.es: Si no se hubiera mudado a Londres, no hablaría tan bien inglés.

examples.en: If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken to her at the party.
examples.es: Si no fuera tan tímido, le habría hablado en la fiesta.

items.bad: If I would have known, I would have told you.
items.good: If I had known, I would have told you.
items.why: Nunca would en la parte del if (igual que en español: si habría sabido → si hubiera sabido).

items.bad: If she had studied, she would pass the exam last week.
items.good: If she had studied, she would have passed the exam last week.
items.why: El resultado también es pasado → would have + participio.

items.bad: I would have went with you.
items.why: Después de have va el participio (3.ª columna), no el pasado.
items.why_en: Use the past participle after have.

items.bad: If we had leave earlier, we would have caught the train.
items.good: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the train.

items.why: Después de would, could o might va have, nunca had.

items.bad: If you told me before, I would have helped you.
items.good: If you had told me before, I would have helped you.
items.why: La condición también es pasada → past perfect, no past simple.

items.bad: If I'd have known, I'd have come.
items.good: If I'd known, I'd have come.
items.why: En la parte del if no sobra ningún have: had + participio.
items.why_en: No extra have in the if-clause.

items.bad: If I had accepted that job, I would have been rich now.
items.good: If I had accepted that job, I would be rich now.

items.es: Piensa en lo que pasó de verdad: No puse la alarma. Me quedé dormido.
Dale la vuelta: lo afirmativo pasa a negativo y al revés: poner la alarma → no quedarme dormido.
Condición: If + had (hadn't) + participio → If I had set my alarm,
Resultado: would (not) have + participio → I wouldn't have overslept. ¿No es seguro? → might have. ¿Posibilidad? → could have.
items.en: Result: would (not) have + participle (or could / might have).

items.es: ¿El resultado es ahora? → would + infinitivo (mixed): I wouldn't be so tired now.
Revisa: ¿participios correctos? ¿Ningún would en la parte del if? ¿Coma si el if va primero?
items.en: Check: participles, no would after if, comma.

lines.en: I can't believe it. We've missed the flight!
lines.es: No me lo puedo creer. ¡Hemos perdido el vuelo!

lines.en: If we had left home ten minutes earlier, we would have caught it.
lines.es: Si hubiéramos salido de casa diez minutos antes, lo habríamos cogido.

lines.en: Well, if you hadn't spent half an hour looking for your sunglasses, we would have left on time!
lines.es: Pues si no te hubieras pasado media hora buscando las gafas de sol, habríamos salido a tiempo.

lines.en: OK, but if the taxi had arrived when we booked it, we wouldn't have been late.
lines.es: Vale, pero si el taxi hubiera llegado a la hora que lo pedimos, no habríamos llegado tarde.

lines.en: True. And if I'd checked in online, we could have gone straight to the gate.
lines.es: Es verdad. Y si yo hubiera hecho el check-in online, podríamos haber ido directos a la puerta.

lines.en: If we'd caught that plane, we'd be lying on a beach in Crete now.
lines.es: Si hubiéramos cogido ese avión, ahora estaríamos tumbados en una playa de Creta.

lines.en: Stop it! What would you have done if there hadn't been another flight today?
lines.es: ¡Para ya! ¿Qué habrías hecho si no hubiera habido otro vuelo hoy?

lines.en: I'd have cried! Luckily, there's one at six.
lines.es: ¡Me habría echado a llorar! Por suerte, hay uno a las seis.

items.q: If Tom had seen the sign, he would have stopped. → Tom saw the sign.
items.why: He didn't see it, so he didn't stop.

items.q: If it hadn't rained, we would have played. → It rained.
If I'd had my keys, I wouldn't have called you. → I had my keys.

items.q:
I wasn't able to finish the report because my laptop broke. 🔑 COULD
If my laptop hadn't broken, I _____ the report.
items.a: could have finished

items.q:
Thanks to your advice, I didn't make a terrible mistake. 🔑 MADE
If you hadn't advised me, I _____ a terrible mistake.
items.a: would have made

items.q: Si hubiera sabido que venías, habría preparado la cena.
items.a: If I had known (that) you were coming, I would have made dinner.

items.q: No habríamos perdido el tren si hubiéramos salido antes.
items.a: We wouldn't have missed the train if we had left earlier.

items.q: ¿Qué habrías hecho tú en mi lugar?
items.a: What would you have done in my position (in my place)?

items.q: Si no me hubieras ayudado, no habría terminado el proyecto.
items.a: If you hadn't helped me, I wouldn't have finished the project.

items.q: Ella podría haber ganado si no se hubiera caído.
items.a: She could have won if she hadn't fallen (over).

items.q: Si hubiera aceptado aquel trabajo, ahora viviría en Londres.
items.a: If I had accepted that job, I would live (would be living) in London now.

items.q: Quizá habrían venido si se lo hubieras pedido.
items.a: They might have come if you had asked them.

items.q: Si hubiese tenido tu número, te habría llamado.
items.a: If I had had your number, I would have called (phoned) you.

exercises.title: Lee y contesta
exercises.es: Lee el texto. Marca T (true) o F (false) y contesta las preguntas.
exercises.en: Read the text. Tick T or F and answer the questions.
text: Last Monday was supposed to be the most important day of Marta's career: an interview at nine o'clock for her dream job at a design agency in Manchester. Unfortunately, nothing went to plan.

First, she forgot to charge her phone, so her alarm didn't go off and she woke up at quarter past eight. In a hurry, she left her portfolio on the kitchen table, and when she reached the station, the 8.30 train was just leaving. “If I had charged my phone, I would have woken up on time,” she thought. “And if I'd woken up on time, I wouldn't have forgotten my portfolio.”

She arrived forty minutes late, and the manager had already left for another meeting. Marta was devastated. However, a month later she got a job at a different agency, which she loves. “If I had got that first job, I would never have met my amazing team,” she says now.

items.q: Marta's alarm didn't go off because her phone was dead.
She caught the 8.30 train.
items.why: The train was just leaving when she reached the station.

items.q: She had her portfolio with her at the interview.
items.why: She left it on the kitchen table.

items.q: Marta is happy in her current job.
Why did Marta wake up late?
items.a: Because she forgot to charge her phone, so her alarm didn't go off.

items.q: Complete Marta's thought: If I had woken up on time, ____.
items.a: I wouldn't have forgotten my portfolio.

items.q: What would have happened if Marta had got the first job, according to her?
items.a: She would never have met her amazing team.

exercises.title: Ahora escribe tú
exercises.es: Escribe sobre tu propia vida. Usa el third conditional y, en la última, un mixed conditional.

items.q: Piensa en un error que cometiste. Escribe 2 frases: If I had…, I would have…
items.a: Ej.: If I had studied more for my driving test, I would have passed the first time. I wouldn't have spent so much on lessons.

items.q: Escribe una frase de alivio: algo malo que al final NO pasó.
items.a: Ej.: If my friend hadn't reminded me, I would have missed my flight to Dublin.

items.q: Critica (con educación) algo que hizo otra persona.
items.a: Ej.: If you had told us about the change, we wouldn't have gone to the wrong office.

items.q: Escribe un mixed conditional sobre tu vida: If I had…, I would… now.
items.a: Ej.: If I had chosen a different degree, I would be working in a hospital now.

checklist.es: Sé formar el third conditional: If + had + participio, would have + participio.
checklist.en: I can form the third conditional.

checklist.es: Uso could have y might have para matizar el resultado.
checklist.en: I can use could have and might have in the result.

checklist.es: Expreso arrepentimientos, críticas y alivio sobre el pasado.
checklist.en: I can express regrets, criticism and relief about the past.
I can tell 'd = had from 'd = would.

checklist.es: Nunca pongo would en la parte del if.
checklist.en: I never use would in the if-clause.

checklist.es: Uso un mixed conditional cuando el resultado es ahora.
checklist.en: I can use a basic mixed conditional.
